en: Black-and-white nighttime view of a long road bridge over a calm river, with streetlights illuminating the bridge and their reflections on the water. Trees and bushes frame the right foreground, and buildings are visible on the far riverbank. White printed caption text appears in Swedish at the bottom left, and publisher/photographer information with a number is printed at the bottom right.
